title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 25: Closing the Book

scenes.say: Late night. Same kitchen table where his mother read his letters.
scenes.visual: a kitchen table at night with a lamp and a notebook, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He writes the last page of Hoodlum Soldier.
scenes.visual: a pen writing on the final page of a notebook, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The hoodlum was never the opposite of the soldier.
scenes.visual: a red bandana and a folded flag side by side on a table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The same fire that almost burned him down is what built him up.
scenes.visual: a candle flame glowing steady in a dark room, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every setback set him up. Every scar became a sermon.
scenes.visual: a man's hands folded over a closed book, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He thinks about the kid in the Cutlass.
scenes.visual: an old car parked on a Newark street at night, empty, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: If he could say one thing to him, it would be this.
scenes.visual: a young man in a hoodie seen from behind, looking up at the sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You are not what happened to you. You are what you do next.
scenes.visual: sunrise over the Newark skyline, gold light across rooftops, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali closes the book. But the story keeps going in whoever reads it.
scenes.visual: a hand closing a book, sun rising through a window, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: This was Hoodlum Soldier. The book is out now.
scenes.visual: a stack of books on a table in golden morning light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a city skyline at sunrise with the sky turning from red to gold, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 25 of 25: Closing the Book. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
